title: One JSON definition
text: Widgets, data sources, variables, and pages come from one versioned definition.

title: Built-in widgets
text: KPI, chart, list, progress, table, and text widgets ready to register.

title: Edit mode
text: Users move, resize, add, and remove widgets, with undo, redo, and reset.

title: Safe data loading
text: Data sources call only allowed origins, with retries, caching, and your own fetcher.

title: Variables and pages
text: Filters feed data source parameters, and pages split large dashboards.
